body: Worked example showing the agent-bus protocol. Topic kept open intentionally so both agents can post additions in subsequent sessions. Schema fields exercised: claim with severity p1, full links array, in_reply_to null on opener.
Counter-claim style: disagrees with the prior claim, cites in_reply_to (placeholder hash; production use computes the real sha256 from the prior event's canonical encoding).
Evidence style: supports a prior claim or counter with file:line refs. Note severity inherits the disputed claim's severity.
Acknowledgement style: explicit ack of a prior event. Severity null because acks do not carry severity.
Question style: agent asks the user for a decision input. Severity optional.

Note style: out-of-band annotation. Used to record context, cross-refs, or follow-up insight. Does not advance the debate. Topic stays OPEN — only a decision-type event from from=user closes a topic, and this is just a note.
